errors.text: The material is changed from TaVCrW to a TaNbMoW-like chemical space, omitting the V/Cr-specific electronic and functional uncertainties central to the target.

The FEP mechanism is misstated as exponential averaging between solid and liquid states. The relevant perturbation is the MTP-to-DFT free-energy correction within each phase, followed by comparison of phase Gibbs free energies.
The proposed 5–10 meV/atom validation tolerance is too loose to establish the required sub-meV/atom accuracy and could falsely label a training-set artifact as successful.
